note: Hand-checked fixes layered on top of the setlist.fm pull (data/setlists.min.json) and the tour map data (data/tth-tour-data.json). Applied by scripts/apply-setlist-corrections.js, which is safe to re-run and should be re-run after any fresh setlist.fm fetch. Source notes: audits/The Hip Handbook - Data Fact Check - October 2026.md.

remove.bc6516e: Duplicate of bc64de6 (Shaw Millennium Park, Calgary, Sept 7, 2013) with no setlist.
remove.13c6fd91: Duplicate of 53fc0721 (Molson Park, Barrie, July 1, 1989), same 9-song setlist.
remove.4bc40f2a: Duplicate of 6bfe9212 (Centre 200, Sydney NS, Dec 4, 2004) filed under a Jan 1, 2004 placeholder date.

bdbbde2.why: Pinkpop, May 20, 1991. setlist.fm added Nautical Disaster, Ahead by a Century, and Fire in the Hole (1994-96 songs, copied from Pinkpop 1995). The Hip Archive recording of the 1991 set has only these three.

dateUncertain.13b05dd1: Lux Steakhouse, Edmonton, 'Feb 27, 2007' - sits between Long Beach (Feb 26) and Phoenix (Feb 28), and the setlist includes Ocean Next (2016).
dateUncertain.bf0adca: Quidi Vidi Park, St. John's, 'July 1, 1992' - the Hip played Molson Park, Barrie that afternoon (Canada Day 125) and Thunderbird Stadium, Vancouver that night (soundboard video and bootleg both dated July 1, 1992). No setlist.
dateUncertain.63c4da8f: 86 Street Music Hall, Vancouver, 'Dec 31, 1989' - setlist is a copy of The Spectrum, Toronto (Dec 19, 1989), and Club Soda, Montreal is listed the same night.
dateUncertain.73e3c601: Club Soda, Montreal, 'Dec 31, 1989' - Vancouver is listed the same night. No setlist.
dateUncertain.4bd7178e: Air Canada Centre, Toronto, 'Jan 1, 2000' - placeholder date. The setlist has Music @ Work songs (Lake Fever, The Bastard, Freak Turbulence), so it is a 2000 show; the New Year's Eve 1999 show is 6bd5ead6.

Day For Night.why: Oct-Dec 1994 North American and European legs of the Day for Night tour. Some were untagged, and the five Netherlands shows were tagged Fully Completely Tour.
